يستأنوا (form X)
# يَسْتَأْنُوا (yastaʔnū) /jas.taʔ.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْنَى (istaʔnā)
# يُسْتَأْنَوْا (yustaʔnaw) /jus.taʔ.naw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْنَى (istaʔnā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
